entity.name: LP 365
entity.description:
Lease Portfolio 365 (LP365) is a secure, cloud-based SaaS platform that simplifies lease management for businesses with multiple locations. It empowers Legal, Finance, Administration, Strategy, and Operations departments by centralizing data, enhancing collaboration, and improving decision-making.

LP365 provides modular functionality for essential lease areas like rental tracking, renewals, CAM charges, and document storage. Each lease is assigned a unique ID for centralized access to agreements, amendments, and communication history. Automated invoice generation and approval workflows facilitate timely payments and compliance with audit requirements.

The platform’s Rent Roll and Revenue Share modules offer real-time insights into lease expenses, aiding in projections, payment reconciliation, and financial planning. It also features geo-mapping and expansion analysis for visibility into lease footprint, average rent per square foot, and regional outlet distribution.

Customisable reports, from lease abstracts to payment history, are easily downloadable and offer robust data for internal reviews and board-level decision-making. With automated alerts for critical dates, such as renewals and terminations, businesses can eliminate last-minute surprises.

LP365 supports role-based access, SOC 2 compliance, and secure landlord interfaces, promoting transparency while safeguarding sensitive data. The platform also integrates seamlessly with sales, ERP, and accounting systems through API connectivity, ensuring smooth data flow and operational synergy.

Whether scaling rapidly or managing an extensive and complex lease portfolio, LP365 delivers control, clarity, and compliance all in one place.
